citation.title: NTUC Link Credit Card by Trust

annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Annual Interest Rate: From 1 July 2026 onwards, credit card Effective Interest Rate (EIR) is personalized based on credit behaviour and ranges from 18.9% p.a to 29.9% p.a.
annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Minimum Monthly Repayment: (a) The greater of either S$50 or 1% of principal, plus (b) interest, finance fees and charges, and (c) any overlimit amount and past due amount.

our_takes.our-take: The NTUC Link Credit Card by Trust shines for everyday spending, especially at FairPrice Group, offering up to 21% savings on groceries and food. A huge plus is no foreign transaction fees, which means real savings for overseas trips or online shopping in foreign currencies. The Trust app simplifies tracking rewards and managing payments. Be mindful that interest accrues daily if you don't pay in full, so aim to clear your balance by the due date. It's a solid choice if you want to avoid hidden fees while earning on essential spending.
our_takes.good-for:
Ideal for budget-conscious families seeking substantial savings on their frequent grocery runs at FairPrice.
Perfect for individuals who travel often and wish to avoid foreign transaction fees and get great exchange rates.
Great for individuals who want to maximize rewards on petrol purchases at Caltex or Esso stations with significant discounts.
our_takes.things-to-note:
Late payment fees of $100 apply; set up payment reminders to avoid these costly charges.
26.9% EIR is charged daily on unpaid balances; pay in full to avoid high-interest costs.
Cash advances accrue interest immediately; avoid using them unless absolutely necessary and repay promptly.
